## Features
- IP65 waterproof LED string lights
- Connectable upto 100m length
- Warm and cool long-life LEDs

Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a white rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long-lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White or Warm White to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

## Features
- Black Cable and Battery Box (click to close)
- Suitable for indoor and outdoor use
- Connect together using a MaleFemale connector
- Auto Timer (6 hours ON 18 hours OFF)
- Multiple sets can be connected together

## Information
Multi-Function (8 Settings). Waterproof LED Lights. Supplied with 10m extension cable. Can add connect or disconnect lights to every set. Supplied in lengths of 100 LEDs or 300 LEDs which can be easily connected. Easily stored and has less chance of tangling. 10cm between LED's. D Sized Battery Box. Easy 'Click to Close' Waterproof black battery box with rubber seal (no fiddly screws). Auto Timer (6 hours on 18 hours off). All of our 'Connectable series are interchangeable, from the lights to the power sources. Realise that you have too many lights for a battery box and they are starting to dim You can easily change it to a Low Voltage Plug. No plug socket near your lights Why not add an extension cable or change over to a battery box Didn't buy enough lights You can easily purchase more and just connect them together. Decided that there aren't enough lights around your Christmas tree You can change the string lights to cluster lights or connect more. Easier to store, and with less tangle, as they can easily be disconnected again when you put them away after Christmas.

9793200.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Suitable for indoor and outdoor use
- Battery operated for hassle-free installation
- Weather resistant design with water sealed battery pack
- Includes a timer function for 8 hours on and 16 hours off
- Offers 8 different light modes
- Total length of 4.4 meters with a 3.9 meter lighted length
- Lead cable to the first bulb is 50 cm
- Distance between each light is 10 cm
- Requires 4x 1.5V AA batteries (not included)

## Information
Perfect for indoor and outdoor use, these Christmas lights add festive charm and create a cozy atmosphere. Offering 8 unique lighting modes, they allow you to set the perfect holiday mood with options like gentle twinkle or steady glow. The energy-saving timer function automatically turns them off and on, saving battery life while providing convenience. Weather-resistant and durable, they are ideal for outdoor use, with a sealed battery pack ensuring safe and reliable operation in various conditions. Designed for 36 months, these lights are perfect for holiday decoration, offering flexibility and ease of use in both indoor and outdoor settings.
